cohort: 356 women with multiple pregnancy (261 spontaneous conception, 95 ART conception).
finding: Caesarean section delivery predominates in women with multiple pregnancy after spontaneous conception, while all women with multiple pregnancy after ART gave birth by Cesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: Among women with multiple pregnancy after spontaneous conception, 66.7% had a caesarean section delivery, compared to 100% of women with multiple pregnancy after ART.
